services.name: Our Horses
services.desc: Interested in becoming an experienced horse person? At RockMeadow you will learn how to handle your horse from the moment you walk into their stall to becoming an advanced horse person on the ground and in the saddle. Start your journey by signing up for our Intro to Horses 101 Class. This class concentrates on what you’ll need to know about handling horses on the ground. You will learn how to safely interact with your horse, handle your horse in different scenarios around the farm, groom and tack your horse properly, basic feed and care of your horse. These classes are scheduled 2 days/week for 4 weeks. You will need to commit to all the dates in one class as there will be no make up
